heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear in the evening, then increasing cloud cover overnight. Lows in the upper 30s to mid 40s, coolest in the northeast. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Showers developing in the west in the early morning then spreading east by midday. Cool. Highs in the 50s. Wind becoming south at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Scattered showers north, steady showers south, retreating overnight. Lows in the low to mid 40s, a few 30s possible in the cold spots.
